text:
Hi,

Claire here, from Nora Lanelle. Day five, and your order has not shipped yet. We said we would write first, so this is that note. Your piece is still being prepared and goes out as soon as it is packed. The day it ships you get the tracking link, and from that day it is 7 to 10 days to your door. Your thirty days to decide start the day it lands, easy returns.

The choice is yours. Rather wait? Do nothing; the tracking link will come. Rather not? One mail to support@nora-lanelle.com with your order number and we refund in full to the card you paid with, no questions. A real person answers in one to two business days. One order, one charge, and it stays that way.

https://nora-lanelle.com/pages/contact

Take care,
Claire
— Nora Lanelle Care
